integrity.claim_scope: Every finite simple complete multipartite root graph with at least two nonempty parts, with initially uniform line-graph vertex colouring
integrity.proof_basis: Closed neighbour-degree moment identity and transitive root-automorphism subgroup

limitations: No identification or amenability theorem for other input graphs
Finite checks cannot prove an all-sizes theorem
title: Two-round orbit recovery for line graphs of complete multipartite graphs
